facts.fact: Gabonreview reports that the vice-president of the personal data and privacy protection authority (APDPVP), Samuel Moussounda Ikamou, received a TikTok delegation on 26 November 2026.
The APDPVP, led on the day by its vice-president, met a TikTok delegation on 26 November 2026 on compliance with Gabonese rules and user protection.

GAB.note: No law named; the meeting is talks, not a decision.
No criticism, cut or punishment stated.
